<canvas id="salesLossChart" style="height:100%; width:100%"></canvas>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<script>
(function(scope) {
    if (scope.chart) return; // avoid re-creating

    const ctx = document.getElementById("salesLossChart").getContext("2d");

    const timeLabels = [];
    const salesData = [];
    const lossData = [];

    const chart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: timeLabels,
            datasets: [
                {
                    label: 'Sales (₹)',
                    data: salesData,
                    borderColor: 'green',
                    fill: false,
                    tension: 0.3
                },
                {
                    label: 'Loss (₹)',
                    data: lossData,
                    borderColor: 'red',
                    fill: false,
                    tension: 0.3
                }
            ]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            scales: {
                x: {
                    ticks: {
                        autoSkip: false,
                        maxRotation: 90,
                        minRotation: 45
                    },
                    title: {
                        display: true,
                        text: 'Day-HH:mm'
                    }
                },
                y: {
                    title: {
                        display: true,
                        text: 'Amount (₹)'
                    },
                    beginAtZero: true
                }
            },
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    position: 'top'
                }
            }
        }
    });

    scope.chart = chart;

    scope.$watch('msg', function(msg) {
        if (!msg) return;

        const now = new Date();
        const dayStr = now.toLocaleString('en-IN', { weekday: 'short' });
        const hour = now.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
        const minute = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
        const label = `${dayStr}-${hour}:${minute}`;

        // Update labels and datasets
        timeLabels.push(label);
        salesData.push(msg.sales || 0);
        lossData.push(msg.loss || 0);

        // Limit to last 24 entries
        if (timeLabels.length > 24) {
            timeLabels.shift();
            salesData.shift();
            lossData.shift();
        }

        chart.update();
    });
})(scope);
</script>
<button onclick="downloadCSV()">Download CSV</button>
<script>
let csvData = [];

function addToCSV(label, sales, loss) {
    csvData.push(`${label},${sales},${loss}`);
    if (csvData.length > 100) csvData.shift(); // Keep only latest 100 rows
}

function downloadCSV() {
    let csvContent = "data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,Time,Sales,Loss\n" + csvData.join("\n");
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.setAttribute("href", encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute("download", "sales_loss_log.csv");
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
}

// Hook into $watch
scope.$watch('msg', function(msg) {
    if (!msg) return;

    const now = new Date();
    const label = now.toLocaleString('en-IN');
    addToCSV(label, msg.sales, msg.loss);
});
</script>
